name: lw-translate-admin
description: LW Translate admin UI (React, WordPress components).

scripts.i18n: wp i18n make-pot . languages/lw-translate.pot --slug=lw-translate --domain=lw-translate --exclude=node_modules,vendor,src,tests,docs && msgmerge --quiet --update --backup=none --no-fuzzy-matching languages/lw-translate-hu_HU.po languages/lw-translate.pot && msgfmt languages/lw-translate-hu_HU.po -o languages/lw-translate-hu_HU.mo && wp i18n make-json languages --no-purge
